transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I’m just tired all the time. I work as a claims adjuster, and honestly, by midmorning... after just reviewing some files or walking a junior adjuster through a claim, it feels like my body and my brain are already running on empty.
Have you been feeling down or hopeless most of the day lately?

Yeah, I would say so. Most days... it just feels like there’s a gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being really kind, or we’re cooking together with the family, I don't really feel it. I just kind of go through the motions without actually feeling the enjoyment I used to have.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been quite a while. I'd say about three years and three months. It really started right around the time I was moved into a higher-responsibility role at work... they had me start mentoring the newer adjusters and overseeing all the new workflow systems. It's just been going on ever since then.
During these three years, have you had any period of at least two months when you felt back to your usual self?
No, I really haven't. Um... I might have a decent day here or there, but definitely not a stretch of two whole months. It's pretty much just been this same heavy feeling the entire time.
Have you had any thoughts of suicide during this period?
No, I haven't. Um... even though I feel down and I'm really tired of this heavy feeling, I've never actually thought about ending my life or hurting myself. I don't have thoughts like that.
During this same period, have you had trouble sleeping or been sleeping much more than usual?

No, not really. My sleep has actually been fine. I haven't had any trouble falling asleep, and I'm not sleeping the day away or anything like that. It's pretty much just been my normal routine as far as sleep goes.
During this period, have you often felt badly about yourself or felt that you were not good enough?

No, I wouldn't say so. Um, I don't really beat myself up or feel like I'm not good enough. I know I'm capable and all that. It's not really an issue with my self-esteem... it's just that constant heavy mood I mentioned earlier.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions during this period?
No, my concentration has been fine. I haven't noticed any issues with focusing at work or making decisions. My mind feels clear enough, it's really just the mood that's the problem.
During this period, have you noticed any change in your appetite?
No, I haven't noticed any changes there. My appetite has been pretty normal, honestly. I'm just eating my regular meals like I always do, so that hasn't been an issue.
During this period, have you often felt hopeless about the future?

Yes, I have. I just keep thinking that this is exactly what the rest of my working life is going to be like. Um, just more audits and systems and pressure... and I can't really picture things feeling lighter again.
